summary: 52-year-old man with a possible broken leg about a half mile below Lake Como on Como Road; his wife received his SPOT distress signal and called for help; AVSAR team drove and hiked in, reached him ~8:13 p.m., carried him down to Base Camp and transferred him to EMS ~9:40 p.m.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR / Alamosa County SO
notes: Date = mission date per AVSAR narrative; subject on trail below Lake Como.
